_comment: Fraction of the secular-equilibrium natural-U dose rate carried by each chain segment. U238 = 238U-234Th-234Pa; U234 = 234U; Th230 = 230Th-226Ra; Rn222 = 222Rn and daughters to 210Po; U235 = 235U-231Th; Pa231 = 231Pa and daughters. Generated by tools/derive_u_series_partition.py.
source: Adamiec G. & Aitken M. (1998) Dose-rate conversion factors: update. Ancient TL 16(2): 37-50, Tables 2, 3 and 5. doi:10.26034/la.atl.1998.292 (CC BY 4.0)
